post.title: Liskov Substitution Principle Demystified: The Heart of Polymorphism
post.subtitle: Understand how behavioral subtyping preserves correctness in Java application architectures.
post.brief: The Liskov Substitution Principle (LSP) mandates that subclasses must be substitutable for their superclasses without changing the correctness of the program. It shifts our understanding of inheritance from syntax (IS-A) to behavior (behaves-like).
